subject: Re: Application ML Engineer
body:
Hi Arslan,

thanks for reaching out. Your background looks great and we'd like to invite you to a 30-minute video interview. Would Thursday 1 October at 14:00 work for you?

Best,
Lena

subject: Re: Backend Engineer
body:
Hello,

We would like to get to know you better. Please pick a time for a first interview here: https://calendly.com/acme-hr/first-interview

Kind regards
Tom

subject: AW: Bewerbung
body:
Hallo Arslan,

vielen Dank für Ihre Nachricht. Wir würden Sie gerne zu einem ersten Kennenlerngespräch einladen. Hätten Sie am Montag, 5. Oktober um 11 Uhr Zeit?

Viele Grüße
Julia

subject: Re: Hello
body:
Hi! Let's set up a quick call with our head of engineering next week. When are you free?

Cheers, Max

subject: Re: Application
body:
Thanks Arslan! The team reviewed your CV. Next step would be a technical interview with two engineers - are you available sometime next week?

Best, Sara

subject: Re: Application
body:
Hi Arslan,

thanks, this sounds interesting! Could you send us your CV and a short summary of your ML projects? We'll review it with the team.

Best, Anna

subject: AW: Initiativbewerbung
body:
Hallo,

danke für Ihr Interesse an uns. Klingt spannend! Schicken Sie uns gerne Ihren Lebenslauf und Ihr Portfolio, dann melden wir uns.

Beste Grüße
Markus

subject: Re: Hello Beta
body:
Thanks for getting in touch - your profile fits what we are building. Can you share your GitHub or some code samples?

Paul

subject: Re: ML Engineer
body:
Hi Arslan,

before we continue: do you currently have a work permit for Germany, or would you need visa sponsorship? And what are your salary expectations?

Thanks,
Sara

subject: AW: Bewerbung Backend
body:
Hallo Herr Ali,

ab wann könnten Sie frühestens anfangen und wie ist Ihre Kündigungsfrist?

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Peter Braun

subject: Re: Hello
body:
Quick question: are you open to working on-site in Munich three days a week, or only remote?

Best, Kim

subject: Re: Hello
body:
Hi Arslan, thanks for writing. Which of our open roles are you applying for - the data engineer or the ML platform role?

Best, Nina

subject: Re: Interview Thursday
body:
Hi Arslan,

confirming our interview on Thursday at 14:00. Here is the video link: https://meet.google.com/abc-defg-hij

See you then,
Lena

subject: Re: Our call
body:
Hi, something came up - could we move our call from Wednesday to Friday 9 October at 10:30?

Sorry for the short notice, Tom

subject: AW: Termin
body:
Hallo Arslan,

hiermit bestätige ich unseren Termin am Dienstag um 15 Uhr in unserem Büro in der Friedrichstraße 10.

Bis dann
Julia

subject: Re: Application
body:
Hello,

thank you for your interest. We only accept applications through our careers portal, please apply here: https://jobs.acme.de/ml-engineer

Kind regards, HR Team

subject: AW: Bewerbung
body:
Guten Tag,

bitte bewerben Sie sich über unser Bewerberportal unter https://karriere.beta.io/stellen. Bewerbungen per E-Mail können wir leider nicht berücksichtigen.

Ihr Recruiting-Team

subject: Re: Hello
body:
Hi Arslan, thanks! Please submit your application via the Personio form on our website so it reaches the right team.

Best, Nina

subject: Re: ML role
body:
Hi Arslan,

I'm not the right person for this, but I've forwarded your email to our CTO, Ben Weber. He will get back to you.

Best,
Anna

subject: Re: Application
body:
Hello, please reach out to our talent lead Maria Lopez at maria.lopez@gamma.fr - she handles all engineering hiring.

Thanks, Luc

subject: AW: Anfrage
body:
Hallo Arslan,

für technische Stellen ist Herr Klein zuständig (klein@delta.de). Ich habe ihn in Kopie gesetzt.

Grüße
Sabine

subject: Re: Application
body:
Hi Arslan,

thank you for your application. We don't have an opening that matches right now, but we will keep your CV on file and contact you when something comes up.

Best regards, HR

subject: AW: Initiativbewerbung
body:
Hallo Herr Ali,

derzeit haben wir keine passende Stelle, wir nehmen Ihre Unterlagen aber gerne in unseren Talentpool auf und melden uns bei passenden Vakanzen.

Freundliche Grüße

subject: Re: Hello
body:
Nothing open at the moment, but I've saved your profile and will reach out in Q1 when we plan new hires.

Cheers, Jonas

subject: Re: Application
body:
Hello Arslan,

thanks for your message. Unfortunately we are not hiring at the moment due to a hiring freeze.

Kind regards, Anna

subject: AW: Bewerbung
body:
Hallo,

leider stellen wir aktuell keine neuen Mitarbeiter ein.

Viele Grüße
Team Epsilon

subject: Re: Hello
body:
Hi, we are a small team and currently have no open positions. Good luck with your search!

Mark

subject: Re: ML Engineer application
body:
Dear Arslan,

thank you for your interest. After careful review we have decided not to move forward with your application, as we are looking for someone with more senior experience.

Best wishes, HR

subject: AW: Ihre Bewerbung
body:
Sehr geehrter Herr Ali,

nach sorgfältiger Prüfung müssen wir Ihnen leider mitteilen, dass wir uns für andere Kandidaten entschieden haben.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen

subject: Re: Hello
body:
Hi Arslan, thanks for the chat last week. Unfortunately we don't think it's the right fit for this role.

All the best, Tom

subject: Re: Interview follow-up
body:
Hi Arslan,

thank you for taking the time to interview with us. We've decided to proceed with another candidate for this position.

Kind regards, Kim

subject: Offer - ML Engineer
body:
Hi Arslan,

we are delighted to offer you the position of ML Engineer at Acme! Attached you'll find the contract. Your start date would be 1 November 2026.

Welcome aboard,
Lena

subject: AW: Vertragsangebot
body:
Hallo Arslan,

wir freuen uns, Ihnen die Stelle als Backend Engineer anzubieten. Den Arbeitsvertrag senden wir Ihnen bis Freitag zu.

Herzliche Grüße
Julia

subject: Re: Next steps
body:
Great news - the team loved you and we'd like to make you an offer: 72k EUR base plus equity. Can you let us know by 10 October?

Best, Paul

subject: Re: Hello
body:
Please remove me from your mailing list and do not contact me again.

Thanks

Bitte kontaktieren Sie uns nicht mehr. Wir wünschen keine weiteren E-Mails.

MfG

Max
